answer: A generative model enables the ability to generate new data by sampling from a probabilistic model [uow_ai_ml_p037_paragraph_001]. It can produce novel examples such as images of horses that have never existed but still look real, having learned the general rules governing their appearance [uow_ai_ml_p038_paragraph_001]. Generative modeling can create new samples from existing examples [uow_ai_ml_p039_paragraph_001].

Generative learning
What is it?

By sampling from this model, we are able to generate new

Generative learning
Scenario
Suppose we have a dataset containing images of horses. We may
wish to build a model that can generate a new image of a horse
that has never existed but still looks real because the model has
learned the general rules that govern the appearance of a horse.
This is the kind of problem that can be solved using generative
modeling.
